mustProve: The desktop frontend bundle can be emitted into apps/desktop/dist.
The native preflight explains missing Rust or macOS prerequisites truthfully.
The native build command resolves into a macOS-targeted dry-run packaging command without pretending to produce an artifact.
mustNotClaim: Local Windows dry-run output is a shippable desktop artifact.

mustProve: A macOS runner can install the required Node and Rust toolchains.
The desktop bundle and native preflight both pass on macOS.
The repo can reach a valid package command shape before signing and notarization are wired.

shippableArtifactProof: A macOS package lane performs real bundle generation instead of placeholder failure.
Apple signing credentials are configured through CI secrets, not local placeholders.
Notarization completes successfully and the final trust step is recorded.
Artifact hash, version, and distribution metadata are captured in release records.
Release docs still state any remaining platform limits truthfully.
knownCurrentLimitations: This Windows machine does not produce a real Mac artifact.
The workflow package job is still placeholder-only until signing and notarization are implemented.
Rust and cargo-tauri availability must be validated on the target build host.
